plan.notes: Source: official Saint Francis University 4-year 'paradigm' (degree plan) for Computer Science, B.S., 'as of Fall 2025', published on the university's official portal my.francis.edu (https://my.francis.edu/ICS/icsfs/CPSC_BS_Fa2024.pdf?target=a8885331-2ee4-4b4e-889e-af67bc936b76). The program's true degree name per the official catalog (catalog.francis.edu, Programs of Study A-Z) is 'Computer Science, B.S.' with 128 credits minimum; the paradigm's own published total is TOTAL 128. Catalog year recorded as 2025-2026 per the paradigm's 'as of Fall 2025' header (no Fall 2026 paradigm is published; the 2026-2027 catalog lists the same Computer Science, B.S. degree). Transcription: PDF downloaded from the official portal and read with pdftotext -layout plus visual verification of the rendered page; term totals and the 128-credit grand total verified against the PDF. Per-course prereqs are NOT published in the paradigm, so all prereq lists are empty (not invented) and external_prereqs is empty. CPSC 121/L is the paradigm's row 1 'CPSC 121 / CORE 9' entry (4 credits) and satisfies CORE 9 Natural Science. CLTR 1/2/3 are the collateral-set choice slots: Mathematics set (MATH 121, MATH 122, MATH 322) or Business set (STAT 205, BUSA 321, BUSA 322). Track electives: student completes 2 of 4 tracks (18 credits; 3 courses per chosen track); TRK1 slots belong to the first chosen track and TRK2 slots to the second. CORE 103/104 are required 0-credit Community Enrichment courses (required_zero=true). The paradigm states: 'Course sequence may be altered with advisor approval.'
